b.x: This does not forecast. It is not the Foresee Protocol. It is the window. On the other side are the main notes on X about what is moving in the world: conflict, water, fire, government, the street. One note is one note. Three sources that do not copy each other, in the same direction, are what enter the count. While it is only one, you do not change the week and you do not tell it in the hall. Open, read, close.
